not_covered: Google acquired the cloud-security firm Wiz to close its security gap with competitors AWS and Azure, betting on cloud-security consolidation as the next battleground in the "cloud wars" driven by AI-driven cloud adoption [Source: ev-1].
The deal signaled that securing a dominant position in cloud security is critical for maintaining competitiveness against major rivals like Amazon and Microsoft. [Source: ev-1]
The acquisition was announced on 2025-03-18 for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash transaction, marking the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].
This final price point followed Wiz’s rejection of an earlier offer from Google worth $23 billion in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
